facts.summary: Publication of positive case report and conference data · Phase 2 · agenT-797 in gastric and testicular cancer · not yet approved
facts.indication: 2L gastric cancer; germ cell tumor (testicular cancer)

evidence.summary: announced the publication of another landmark case in Nature's Oncogene describing a complete and durable remission in a patient with metastatic, treatment-refractory testicular cancer, following treatment with agenT-797
evidence.safety: treatment was well-tolerated with no cytokine release syndrome (CRS) or graft-versus-host disease (GVHD).
